relations.subject: security:gcp-private-link
relations.evidence: GCP Private Service Connections can support [Cross Datacenter Replication (XDCR)](../clusters/xdcr/xdcr.md) or [Prometheus metrics](../clusters/monitoring/prometheus.md). These features are only available upon request and are subject to specific conditions.

notable_absence.finding: No data-plane privilege/RBAC content - only a management-plane role gate, a support-plan gate, and a region-matching cloud-provider constraint ('The region set to the same region as your GCP VPC'), which has no ontology predicate in the current registry and isn't worth minting a one-off predicate for.

cross_component_finding: Same third-wording-variant recurrence for the support-plan gate as add-aws-private-link.json ('Enterprise plan' rather than 'Enterprise Support Plan'/'Enterprise Service Plan'). Also notable: this page offers an SDK-connection-string caveat ('you must add ?network=external to the end of the private endpoint in the connection string... only required for Java, Scala, Kotlin, C++, Node.js, Python, Ruby, and PHP SDKs') that has no equivalent caveat on the AWS or Azure sibling pages - a genuine per-provider behavioral difference, not a gap.
cross_product_finding: GCP Private Service Connect uniquely offers 2 alternative configuration paths (shell script vs Google Terraform Provider) where AWS/Azure only offer the shell-script path - a real product asymmetry across the 3 cloud providers Capella supports.
